assertions.assertion: The patient presents with a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks and unspecified cardiac arrhythmia
The patient reports intermittent episodes of dizziness and palpitations
The patient's symptoms are poorly correlated with standard ECG findings
The patient has unspecified cardiac arrhythmia
A cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) is indicated
The patient may have paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other intermittent dysrhythmias
The patient's intermittent dysrhythmias are not adequately captured by standard ECG findings
